Paul Roderick Ysmael as its fifth witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.
READ: Highlights: Day 42 of Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 11, 2026
‘LONG-TIME FRIEND OF VP SARA’ LOOK: The prosecution presents a photo of defense witness Atty. Anel Martin Antero with Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Atty. Manases Carpio. Antero confirmed that the photo was taken following Rodrigo Duterte’s victory in the 2016 presidential election. Atty. Amando Ligutan: “You have long been a friend of the Vice President?” Antero: “Long-time friend, yes.” #VPonTrial Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/VzEBfjYTXl Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/3blAz92A9J
‘PROBLEMA BA ‘YON ‘PAG HINDI MATANDAAN?’ Senator-judge Robin Padilla questioned whether a defense witness’s trips to China were an issue, citing his own visits to the country, including one with former President Rodrigo Duterte. Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon clarified that the issue was not the trips themselves but the witness’s credibility and truthfulness. #VPonTrial Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/VzEBfjYTXl Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/3blAz92A9J
Defense presents Atty. Anel Martin Antero as witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday, November 12. He will testify that he was in Japan with Duterte’s husband, Mans Carpio on May 19, 2023, and explain the circumstances surrounding a P205,007.29 credit card charge at Ginza Inakaya Tokyo. #VPonTrial | @AprBenjaminINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/VzEBfjYTXl Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/3blAz92A9J
DEFENSE DISPENSES WITH BPI WITNESS Defense counsel Michael Poa says the defense is dispensing with BPI SVP Atty. Paul Roderick Ysmael, saying his testimony was only needed to authenticate a letter that Poa had already admitted to writing in open court. #VPonTrial | @AprBenjaminINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/VzEBfjYTXl Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/3blAz92A9J
The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte will no longer present their witness Atty. Paul Roderick Ysmael, the senior vice president of the Bank of the Philippine Islands. #VPonTrial | @JEMendozaINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/VzEBfjYTXl Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/3blAz92A9J
